description: The Cambridge Dictionary has chosen "human" as its word of the year, reflecting concerns about artificial intelligence.
title: Would AI have come up with a better word of the year than the Cambridge Dictionary?

author: Kate McKenna
description: As talks with the Trump administration begin to ramp up once again, the prime minister's point man on Canada-U.S. trade has been meeting with his counterparts weekly in a more formal way, according to three senior government officials.
title: Trade talks between top Canada, U.S. officials ramping up: sources

author: Lucas McInnis
description: After a Prince Edward Island author won Canada's most prestigious prize for literature, the province's literary community says it could mean more opportunities for writers here at home.
title: 'A huge opportunity': Literary community ecstatic after P.E.I. author's Giller Prize win

description: Nvidia board chair Harvey Jones opened an investor conference call on Tuesday by saying the AI chip company would ‌not rehire co-founder Jensen Huang as CEO and would not take questions on the matter.
title: No plans to reinstate CEO Jensen Huang, Nvidia chair tells investors

author: Associated Press
description: Previous Canadian books featured on Oprah’s Book Club include A Fine Balance by Rohinton Mistry and Fall on Your Knees by Ann-Marie Macdonald.
title: Oprah Winfrey names book by Ontario-born author as her latest book club pick

description: The U.S. Federal Aviation Administration has paused installing routers linked to last week's ground stop that caused chaos for travellers, the agency said Tuesday.
title: FAA halts installation of new routers linked to Friday's airport ground stop until root of problem found

author: Alessia Passafiume
description: The National Congress of American Indians is calling on U.S. President Donald Trump to walk back his August executive order renaming Lake Ontario as Lake America.
title: Trump should reverse Lake Ontario name change, says National Congress of American Indians

author: David Cummings
description: The federal government is writing off billions of dollars' worth of outstanding debt related to COVID-19 benefits sent to individuals it later deemed ineligible.
title: Federal government waives $4.5B of debt on COVID-19 benefits sent to ineligible recipients

description: The International Ice Hockey Federation has confirmed it has been targeted by a cyberattack, with the organization's website offline since Tuesday morning.
title: IIHF confirms cyberattack after website goes offline

description: Grand Theft Auto VI has yet to be released to the general public, but already it's being touted as the potential game of the year. The Game Awards released its nomination list on Tuesday, with Grand Theft Auto VI receiving eight nominations.
title: Grand Theft Auto VI nominated for game of the year, even though it isn't out yet

description: Aiden Pleterski denied ever calling himself the "Crypto King" — or paying for a Forbes sponsored article that did — under cross-examination at the trial for his alleged kidnappers in Toronto on Tuesday.
title: 'Crypto King' or 'Lying King'? Aiden Pleterski says he was neither at alleged kidnappers' trial

author: Courtney Dickson
description: What started as a joke on a late-night sketch comedy show quickly blew up online in the hours following its airing. It’s garnered more than 11.9 million views on Instagram alone, and shared hundreds of thousands of times.
title: B.C. caregivers explain why a recent SNL sketch has struck a nerve

author: Andrew Kurjata
description: Police say injuries are not life-threatening and cleanup is underway.
title: 2 hospitalized after CN Rail train derails into Skeena River near Terrace, B.C.

description: Canada's National Public Alerting System is running tests of its Alert Ready system Wednesday across all provinces and territories. Alert Ready delivers alerts about critical events such as tornadoes, flooding, fires and Amber alerts.
title: Canada's national emergency alert system will sound off Wednesday for testing

description: Britain said on Tuesday it would impose sanctions on eight Israeli construction companies involved in building settlements in the occupied West Bank, as part of its effort to protect the idea of a two-state solution.
title: U.K. sanctions Israeli companies involved in building illegal settlements in West Bank

author: Griffin Jaeger
description: The 2027 Grammy nominees for best new artist dropped Monday, putting a spotlight on who's reshaping the music scene. If you want to keep your playlist fresh — or at least know what everyone in the group chat is talking about — here are the names shaping the conversation.
title: Meet the 2027 Grammy best new artist nominees

author: Philip Drost
description: The Ministry of Justice in the U.K. is investigating whether comedian and convicted rapist Russell Brand is guilty of breaking prison rules after his wife shared a message from Brand on his YouTube channel claiming his innocence.
title: Convicted rapist Russell Brand under investigation for claiming innocence from behind bars

description: Grand Theft Auto VI is set to release on Thursday, marking a return to the neon-lit streets of Vice City. Check out the scenes here and abroad as fan excitement builds for the next instalment in the video game series.
title: IN PHOTOS | Grand Theft Auto VI ads hit the streets

description: Nepal has become the first country to have funding provisionally set aside from the UN's Fund for Responding to Loss and Damage following devastating flooding. But Nepal needs billions to rebuild, and the fund has set aside just millions. From the Himalayas to the COP31 climate summit, can the international community deliver the help vulnerable countries need?
title: Who pays when climate disasters strike?

author: Jeffery Tram
description: Hamilton police are investigating after receiving reports that a group of about 20 to 25 people dressed in black and wearing masks were shouting pro-Nazi comments at a downtown demonstration Saturday.
title: Hamilton police investigate after witnesses report group shouting pro-Nazi comments at demonstration

description: Ukrainian drones and missiles destroyed the central road section of the bridge linking Russia and Crimea on Tuesday, inflicting a military and symbolic blow on Russian President Vladimir Putin two days before he is due to meet the leaders of China and the U.S.
title: Ukraine cripples Crimean bridge in blow to Putin before meeting with Xi, Trump

author: Jessica Singer
description: Krampus, a European Christmas folk creature, has been banned from Strathory, Ont.,'s Santa Claus parade despite winning second place in the event's costume contest last year. Organizers say there were complaints that the figure wasn't "family friendly."
title: Krampus stirs up controversy in Ontario town after being banned from Santa Claus parade

title: Iran fires drones at U.S. base in Bahrain, denies reports of planned dirty bomb attack in D.C.

description: Liberal MPs agreed to make minor changes to a controversial piece of legislation that's supposed to speed up the approval of major projects.

description: Five European countries have embarked on a deal with Rwanda to take in migrants whose asylum claims have been rejected. They are hoping the scheme acts as a deterrent, but a similar plan in Britain
title: 5 European countries want to start deporting migrants to Rwanda, despite concerns from human rights groups

author: Sarah Law
description: The first day of a coroner's inquest into the death of a woman at Lake of the Woods District Hospital in Kenora, Ont., took place via video conference on Monday. Here's what members of the jury heard about the late Kaylee Martha Dallas Crowchild of Tsuut’ina Nation in southern Alberta and how she ended up in northwestern Ontario.
title: Jury in coroner's inquest hears how woman from Alberta died in northwestern Ontario
